def normalize_record(record):
    stage = clean_strings(record)
    stage = normalize_authors(stage)
    stage = normalize_tags(stage)
    result = dict(stage)
    authors = result.get("authors")
    if not isinstance(authors, list):
        authors = []
        result["authors"] = authors
    result["slug"] = derive_slug(stage)
    result["author_count"] = len(authors)
    result["primary_author"] = authors[0] if authors else None
    title = stage.get("title")
    if isinstance(title, str):
        result["title_words"] = len(title.split())
    else:
        result["title_words"] = 0
    tags = result.get("tags")
    if result.get("draft") is True:
        result["visibility"] = "internal"
    elif isinstance(tags, list) and "embargo" in tags:
        result["visibility"] = "restricted"
    else:
        result["visibility"] = "public"
    return result

def normalize_record(record):
    stage = clean_strings(record)
    stage = normalize_authors(stage)
    stage = normalize_tags(stage)
    result = dict(stage)
    authors = result.get("authors")
    if not isinstance(authors, list):
        authors = []
        result["authors"] = authors
    result["slug"] = derive_slug(stage)
    result["author_count"] = len(authors)
    result["primary_author"] = authors[0] if authors else None
    title = stage.get("title")
    if isinstance(title, str):
        result["title_words"] = len(title.split())
    else:
        result["title_words"] = 0
    tags = result.get("tags")
    if result.get("draft") is True:
        result["visibility"] = "internal"
    elif isinstance(tags, list) and "embargo" in tags:
        result["visibility"] = "restricted"
    else:
        result["visibility"] = "public"
    return result
